page.layout: One printed page, a title page in a single centred column with a double-rule border; no running head, page number, or marginal text. Show-through from the reverse side appears faintly in the middle and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: NVM Iesuitam, Pontificium in Collegio Romano, &
THOMAM STAPLETONVM, Regium in Schola Duacena
a Gulielmo Whitakero Theologiæ Doctore, ac Professore Regio,
& Collegij D. Ioannis in Cantabrigiensi Academia Magistro.
Basilius in Epistola ad Eustathium medicum,
Ἡ ἀπόπειρα ... ἡμῖν διαπονεῖσθαι χρεών ... (Greek quotation, partly illegible)
De Ecclesia ... De Scriptura ... (marginal-style list fragments, not legible)
Ex officina THOMAE THOMASII, florentissimæ Cantabrigiensis

page.notes: The Greek line is a quotation of Basil's letter; only its opening words are legible on the scan, so it is given as a partial transcription and marked illegible in part. The faint list of section headings in the middle of the page (De Scriptura, De Ecclesia, etc.) is show-through from the reverse and is not part of the title. Several lines of the title are italic or in a smaller roman in the original (e.g. "Regium in Schola Duacena", "Gulielmo Whitakero"); italics were not marked in the lines above.
